en.labCaveat: This reduced model omits chamber geometry, feature evolution, precursor depletion details, multicomponent chemistry, loading, plasma effects, temperature gradients, and calibration. Do not use its output to select production settings.
en.stressCaveat: Assumes an isotropic elastic substrate, a uniform thin film, small curvature, and an equibiaxial average stress. Silicon is anisotropic; use an appropriate elastic model for real wafer interpretation.
en.cvdCaveat: Assumes steady one-dimensional transport and a first-order surface sink with constant coefficients. It does not model reactor geometry, depletion, gas-phase chemistry, or wafer-scale uniformity.
en.aldCaveat: Assumes a steady one-dimensional feature, constant effective diffusivity, a first-order wall sink, and a single idealized exposure. It is not a cycle-accurate ALD simulator.
en.sign: Sign follows the selected curvature convention; it is not a universal tensile/compressive label.
en.chartLegend: Concentration ratio C/C₀ (blue) · idealized coverage θ (orange)
